cleaner.label: Gemini CLI
cleaner.description: Cache and factory-wipe cleaners for Gemini CLI

option.label: Cache
option.description: Delete Gemini CLI caches, logs, and temporary files.
option.warning: Close Gemini CLI before cleaning. This preserves settings where possible.

option.label: Factory wipe
option.description: Delete Gemini CLI user-level local state.
option.warning: This removes Gemini CLI settings, auth-related state, logs, and caches. You may need to configure or log in again.
